standard_prerequisites.use: Lines 995-1041: in case A resp. case B, images of coverings are coverings by definition and fibre products computed in C_n agree with those in C_total (the claim in the cited lemma's proof).

core_obligations: Continuity and cocontinuity (proof lines 993-1043), argued twice: Case A via lemma-simplicial-site-site and Case B via lemma-simplicial-cocontinuous-site - in both, the image of a covering of C_n is a covering of C_total by definition, fibre products agree by the claim in the cited lemma, and the functor gives a bijection on coverings, whence cocontinuity.
Parts (1), (2) and (5) (lines 1044-1049): the morphism of topoi, the sheaf-level left adjoint g^{Sh}_{n!} and the abelian left adjoint g_{n!} follow from the three cited Sites/Modules lemmas.

Part (3) (lines 1051-1075): build H on C_total degree by degree, H_m = coproduct over phi : [n] -> [m] of f_phi^{-1}G, with transition maps the identifications f_psi^{-1}f_phi^{-1}G = f_{psi o phi}^{-1}G; a map alpha : H -> F restricts to a map G -> F_n on the G-component of H_n, and conversely beta : G -> F_n defines alpha_m on components by the map adjoint to F(varphi) o f_phi^{-1}beta; the two constructions are mutually inverse (the author marks this verification as omitted - auxiliary step, see notes), so H = g^{Sh}_{n!}G.

Part (6) and exactness (lines 1077-1083): the abelian case repeats the construction verbatim with direct sums in place of coproducts, giving H = g_{n!}G with restriction formula (6); the exactness properties of both shrieks (items (4) and (7) of the statement) are read off the displayed formulas.
proof_roadmap: Prove continuity and cocontinuity of each component functor in both site variants (cases A and B).
Cite the Sites and Modules-on-Sites machinery for the topos morphism and the two left adjoints.
Construct g^{Sh}_{n!} (coproducts) and g_{n!} (direct sums) degree by degree and write out the adjunction bijections.
Read the exactness properties off the formulas.
difficulty_reason: Seven-part structural lemma (statement 969-991, proof 993-1083): continuity and cocontinuity are argued in both site variants, the adjoints are cited from Sites and Modules on Sites, and both shriek formulas are proved by an explicit degree-by-degree construction of the left Kan extension with the adjunction bijection written out in both directions (its inverse check is the proof's single 'we omit the arguments' at source line 1056, an auxiliary step recorded in the notes); exactness is read off the formulas. H2: elementary site-theoretic construction, no spectral machinery.
